title: Novel, non-invasive markers for detecting therapy induced neuroendocrine differentiation in castration-resistant prostate cancer patients.
authors: Bhagirath, Divya; Liston, Michael; Akoto, Theresa; Lui, Byron; Bensing, Barbara A; Sharma, Ashok; Saini, Sharanjot
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习分析血清外泌体miRNA和蛋白标志物来检测前列腺癌神经内分泌分化，属于临床生物标志物研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Neuroendocrine prostate cancer (NEPC), a highly aggressive variant of castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC), often emerges upon treatment with androgen pathway inhibitors, via neuroendocrine differentiation. Currently, NEPC diagnosis is challenging as available markers are not sufficiently specific. Our objective was to identify novel, extracellular vesicles (EV)-based biomarkers for diagnosing NEPC. Towards this, we performed small RNA next generation sequencing in serum EVs isolated from a cohort of CRPC patients with adenocarcinoma characteristics (CRPC-Adeno) vs CRPC-NE and identified significant dysregulation of 182 known and 4 novel miRNAs. We employed machine learning algorithms to develop an 'EV-miRNA classifier' that could robustly stratify 'CRPC-NE' from 'CRPC-Adeno'. Examination of protein repertoire of exosomes from NEPC cellular models by mass spectrometry identified thrombospondin 1 (TSP1) as a specific biomarker. In view of our results, we propose that a miRNA panel and TSP1 can be used as novel, non-invasive tools to identify NEPC and guide treatment decisions. In conclusion, our study identifies for the first time, novel non-invasive exosomal/extracellular vesicle based biomarkers for detecting neuroendocrine differentiation in advanced castration resistant prostate cancer patients with important translational implications in clinical management of these patients that is currently extremely challenging.
abstract_zh: 神经内分泌前列腺癌（NEPC）是去势抵抗性前列腺癌（CRPC）的一种高度侵袭性变异，常在雄激素通路抑制剂治疗过程中通过神经内分泌分化而出现。目前，NEPC的诊断具有挑战性，因为现有标志物特异性不足。我们的目标是识别基于细胞外囊泡（EV）的新型生物标志物，用于诊断NEPC。为此，我们对从具有腺癌特征的CRPC患者（CRPC-Adeno）与CRPC-NE患者队列中分离的血清EV进行了小RNA下一代测序，并识别出182个已知和4个新型miRNA的显著失调。我们采用机器学习算法开发了一种“EV-miRNA分类器”，能够稳健地将“CRPC-NE”与“CRPC-Adeno”进行分层。通过质谱分析NEPC细胞模型外泌体的蛋白质组，鉴定出血小板反应蛋白1（TSP1）作为特异性生物标志物。鉴于我们的结果，我们提出miRNA组合和TSP1可作为新型非侵入性工具，用于识别NEPC并指导治疗决策。总之，我们的研究首次识别了基于外泌体/细胞外囊泡的新型非侵入性生物标志物，用于检测晚期去势抵抗性前列腺癌患者的神经内分泌分化，这对这些患者目前极具挑战性的临床管理具有重要的转化意义。
